Alternate_Leg_Diagonal_Bound: From an easy jog, push off one leg forwards and diagonally.
Land on the opposite leg and go straight into the next bound to the other side.
Aim for distance and controlled landings.
Backward_Medicine_Ball_Throw: Stand holding the medicine ball with both hands between your legs.
Bend your hips and knees and, as you extend explosively, throw the ball backwards over your head.
Make sure nobody is behind you.
Bench_Jump: Stand in front of a low, stable bench.
Jump with your feet together onto the bench, landing softly with your knees bent.
Carioca_Quick_Step: Move sideways, crossing one foot in front of and then behind the other.
Keep your hips rotating and your feet quick.
Cover the distance and come back the other way.
Catch_and_Overhead_Throw: Stand facing a partner or a wall with the medicine ball.
Catch the ball overhead and throw it back forcefully with both hands.
Keep your abs braced during the throw.
Chest_Push_multiple_response: Stand with the medicine ball at chest height.
Throw it forcefully forwards by straightening your arms and take a step to follow it.
Pick it up and repeat several times in a row.
Chest_Push_single_response: Stand with the medicine ball at chest height.
Throw it forcefully forwards by straightening your arms.
Pick it up and reset before the next one.
Double_Leg_Butt_Kick: Standing, jump up with both feet.
In the air, kick your heels up towards your glutes.
Land softly and go into the next jump.
Dumbbell_Seated_Box_Jump: Sit on a bench facing a box with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Stand up explosively and jump onto the box.
Step down carefully and sit back down.
Fast_Skipping: Skip forward on the balls of your feet, alternating them.
Drive your knees up and move your arms in coordination.
Aim for speed with short steps.
Front_Box_Jump: Stand in front of a stable box.
Bend your legs slightly, swing your arms and jump onto the box, landing with your knees bent.
Step down and repeat. Choose a safe height.
Front_Cone_Hops_or_hurdle_hops: Set out several cones or low hurdles in a row.
Jump over them with your feet together, linking the jumps.
Hurdle_Hops: Set out several low hurdles in a row.
Jump over them with your feet together, driving your knees up.
Link the jumps with soft landings.
Knee_Tuck_Jump: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Jump up, bringing your knees to your chest.
Land softly and go into the next jump.
Lateral_Bound: Jump sideways as far as you can and land on the other leg.
Lateral_Box_Jump: Stand beside a low, stable box.
Jump sideways onto the box and get down on the other side.
Alternate the direction with controlled landings.
Lateral_Cone_Hops: Jump over it from side to side with your feet together.
Keep the rhythm with soft landings.
Linear_Acceleration_Wall_Drill: Put your hands on a wall with your body leaning and in a straight line.
Drive one knee up and switch legs quickly, as when starting a sprint.
Keep the lean and the rhythm.
Linear_Depth_Jump: Step off to the floor and, as soon as you land, jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly. It is an advanced exercise: start with a low height.
Medicine_Ball_Chest_Pass: Facing a partner or a wall, hold the medicine ball at chest height.
Throw it forcefully by straightening your arms.
Catch it with your arms bent and repeat.
Medicine_Ball_Full_Twist: Stand back to back with a partner, holding the medicine ball.
Rotate your torso to pass it on one side and receive it on the other.
Keep your feet planted and your abs braced.
Medicine_Ball_Scoop_Throw: Stand side-on to a wall with the medicine ball by your hip.
Rotate your hips and throw it forcefully against the wall with a scooping motion.
Pick it up and repeat. Switch sides.
Overhead_Slam: Stand holding the medicine ball overhead.
Slam it forcefully into the floor in front of you, bending your torso.
Catch it on the rebound and repeat. Use a ball that does not bounce too much.
Plyo_Push-up: Lower and push up so hard that your hands leave the floor.
Land with your elbows slightly bent and go into the next one.
Prowler_Sprint: Hold the sled handles with your arms straight and your body leaning.
Push it while running with powerful strides.
Cover the distance and rest before the next one.
Rocket_Jump: Drop into a half squat with your arms down.
Jump up as high as you can, reaching your arms overhead.
Scissors_Jump: Jump and switch legs in the air.
Land in a lunge with the other leg in front and keep going.
Side_Standing_Long_Jump: Stand side-on to the direction of the jump.
Bend your legs and jump sideways as far as you can.
Land on both feet and stabilise.
Side_to_Side_Box_Shuffle: Stand beside a low box with one foot on top.
Jump from one side of the box to the other, switching the foot on top.
Single-Leg_Lateral_Hop: Hop sideways on the same leg and land, stabilising.
Single-Leg_Stride_Jump: Stand beside a low bench with one foot on top.
Push off that leg to jump up and land in the same position.
Do all the reps and switch sides.
Single_Leg_Butt_Kick: From an easy jog, kick the heel of one leg to your glute on each stride.
Keep the rhythm with the other leg taking normal strides.
Switch legs on the next set.
Sledgehammer_Swings: Stand facing a tyre, holding the sledgehammer with both hands.
Lift it over your shoulder and strike the tyre forcefully, sliding your top hand down to the bottom one.
Alternate sides. Keep your feet planted and leave space around you.
Split_Jump: Jump up and land in the same position.
Link the jumps and switch your front leg on the next set.
Standing_Long_Jump: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your legs, swing your arms and jump forward as far as you can.
Land on both feet and stabilise.
Standing_Two-Arm_Overhead_Throw: Stand with the medicine ball overhead.
Throw it forcefully forwards with both hands, like a football throw-in.
Star_Jump: Drop into a half squat with your arms by your sides.
Jump, opening your arms and legs into a star shape.
Bring them in before landing and land softly.
Stride_Jump_Crossover: Stand beside a low bench with one foot on top.
Jump over the bench to the other side, placing the other foot on top.
Supine_Chest_Throw: Lie on your back with the medicine ball at chest height.
Throw it upwards by straightening your arms.
Catch it with control and repeat. Use a light ball or do it with a partner.
Supine_One-Arm_Overhead_Throw: Lie on your back with the medicine ball in one hand overhead.
Sit up slightly and throw it forwards to a partner.
Catch it and repeat. Switch arms.
Supine_Two-Arm_Overhead_Throw: Lie on your back holding the medicine ball with both hands overhead.
Sit up slightly and throw it forwards to a partner.
Vertical_Swing: Stand with your feet apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one end.
Take it between your legs by hinging at the hips and swing it overhead with a hip drive.
Let it come back down between your legs with control.
